proposed_widenings.name: decrease_exhaustion_level
proposed_widenings.justification: SRD Exhaustion has levels 1–6; reducing by one level is mechanically distinct from remove_condition (which removes exhaustion entirely). No existing atom covers partial level reduction.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.

proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation trigger: on_short_rest
proposed_widenings.justification: PassiveOperation.trigger currently only supports elapsed_time. Tireless' Decrease Exhaustion fires on short-rest completion, which is a rest event not an elapsed-time event.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.

notes: Only the Temporary Hit Points half is encoded (activation, Magic action, grant_temp_hp 1d8+Wis mod, use_count capped at Wis modifier, long rest reset). The Decrease Exhaustion half is entirely omitted: it requires (a) a new PassiveOperation trigger kind for short-rest completion and (b) a new atom for partial exhaustion level reduction. The 'minimum of 1' floor on both the HP amount and use-count cap is also not expressible in the current surface but is a minor gap compared to the missing atom/trigger.
